editorial:
Imagine being a wealthy, pampered businessman who thinks he runs the world, only to get dumped on a lonely beach after a shipwreck. That is exactly what happens here. You get to watch a guy who is used to fancy suits and boardrooms suddenly have to figure out how to survive in the wild. It is a funny twist on the old Robinson Crusoe story because our main character is a total city slicker. He has no idea how to build a fire or find food, and watching him struggle while trying to keep his dignity is the best part of the movie. The vibe is lighthearted and makes fun of how dependent we are on modern gadgets and society.

What really works is the lead actor's performance as he slowly goes a bit crazy from the loneliness. The pacing is steady, and while some parts feel a bit slow, the comedy keeps you interested. If you like seeing a spoiled person get a reality check, you will love this. You should definitely try to find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this hidden gem.
endingExplained: After spending a long time alone and losing his mind, the man finally sees a ship and manages to get rescued. However, the twist is that he has changed completely. When he returns to his old life in the city, he finds that he cannot fit in anymore. He realizes that the corporate world he once loved is empty. He ends up missing the simplicity of the island, showing that he found his true self in the wild.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories with a comedic twist.
